🧩 Puzzle of Truth discovery

📜 How to Read the Puzzle

This visualization uses a large language model to map the cognitive landscape of an online discussion about the future of AI. Here, "truth" is defined as having thoroughly examined all perspectives and thought processes by the group of participants.

The puzzle highlights which aspects, perspectives, or lines of thinking have been repeatedly addressed, as well as those that remain underdeveloped or overlooked. Some 🧩 pieces are labeled "limited info," indicating underdeveloped areas where discussion was sparse.

Notice that some puzzle pieces are missing—these represent viewpoints or ideas that received little to no attention, potentially revealing blind spots within this group of participants.

💡 The puzzle visualization offers a unique lens through which to understand the cognitive landscape of participants grappling with complex problems. By meticulously organizing participant comments into distinct "information source" and "thinking process" buckets, the visualization illuminates the prevailing patterns of engagement.

🔬📝 This granular categorization allows us to clearly discern what aspects of the problem space currently command attention and, crucially, where potential blind spots might lie within the existing opinion space. It provides a grounded narrative, directly responding to the raw data of participant thought processes, making the complex interplay of data and cognition accessible and engaging.
